standing_limitations.text: GloFAS river reaches and return-period thresholds are unvalidated: no riverine flood flag is derived from GloFAS in either the bundle path or the fallback path.
Urban (pluvial) inundation has no validated local model: rainfall-rate screening only, kept distinct from river flooding.
Weathernews pollen numeric arrays are retrieved, but operational applicability is unverified while the public pages are closed.
The ECMWF OpenCharts cyclone-product endpoint returns 404 at every walked-back base time (endpoint looks retired); GFS / ECMWF open-data samples are the working alternative.
The regional grids are sparse 3x3 samples: they cannot exclude a storm passing between sampling points, and no verdict of safety rests on them alone.
STOFS levels sit on the NOAA model datum: combined levels are compared only with the STOFS model's own astronomical tide, never with official tide-table datums.

quality_reasons: cwa/tamsui_hourly_tide: no hourly rows for Danshuei station 1102 in this collection; that series is a retained reference only — Taipei's tide product is the official CWA high/low event table, which is ready.
GloFAS grids have not been matched to applicable river reaches and flood thresholds.
Urban inundation warning/risk feeds still need independent city-specific validation; rainfall and GloFAS point discharge alone do not establish inundation depth.
Weathernews pollen numeric arrays were retrieved, but the public pages are closed for spring-season preparation; operational applicability remains unverified.

Regional 3x3 sample grids provide actual 384h mean/spread guidance; official cyclone tracks and warnings must be combined with the grid at 06:00. The grid alone is not complete spatial cyclone coverage.
jma/kagawa_warnings: stale official issue timestamp; not current warning evidence
